paragraphs.text: Tiny is a dog detective from Ravnica .

Tiny was originally a sniffer dog that was in training for the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations but kept failing because he was too trusting of anyone with food. He was eventually paired up with Sophia due to her similarly being unsuccessful at her detective investigations. After being paired up, Sophia learned to rely on Tiny's instincts and his unerring sense of smell, while Tiny, with Sophia as a single consistent food source for him, finally stopped being so distracted by wayward treats. Together, they've been able to make up for each other's weaknesses.
